purpose: Improve A ignition stock choice and pre-entry signal quality while preserving all original date-sector slots; distinguish expectancy improvement from lower participation.

hypotheses.mechanism: Prior industry return ranking may prioritize an already extended breakout; rerank the same admitted A pool by lower breakout extension in volatility units.
hypotheses.support: Development low-extension group near zero, but nonmonotonic and dependent on two winners; no demonstrated edge.

hypotheses.mechanism: Stronger relative amount participation may distinguish a better-supported breakout from a price-only pop; selection occurs after the entire signal day and execution remains next open.
hypotheses.support: Higher relative amount group was less negative in development-year and board cuts, still negative and adaptively explored; no threshold optimization.

rejectedBeforeNewOutcomes.reason: Development positive-gap and nonpositive-gap trades had near-equal risk-budget expectancy; removing positive gaps discards about35percent of executed A trades and lacks quality support. No accounts for this idea are run.

formationContract.universe: Full frozen 4999-stock formation allCandidates; never restrict to the old1120-stock execution projection.
formationContract.slots: Exactly preserve original complete signal date,sector,rank and A/B pattern for every slot; replace only A symbol within the same complete pre-ranking A pool.
formationContract.exitsSizingFeesAdmission: Original complete system unchanged; no stop widening, no leverage increase, no intraday low-touch fills.
formationContract.projection: Freeze all case schedules before projecting full source to their selected-security union.

reusedTemporalCheck.label: Previously exposed temporal retest, not pristine OOS

accounts.jobs: Each case both periods normal; each case reusedTemporalCheck stress. Never compound cold-start periods.

metrics.attribution: A/B fixed at entry pattern; show their closed PnL, unrealized end MTM and unallocated equity bridge residual.
aClosed: mean PnL / originally planned stop-risk budget
participation: A capital-days = sum of end-of-session marked A holdings in yuan
efficiency: A net PnL / (A buy plus sell notional) bps
A net PnL / A capital-days bps per capital-day
A net PnL / all evaluation sessions yuan per session
metrics.matchedSlots: All original A slots retained; no-fill contributes zero slot PnL but is never a zero-return closed trade in expectancy or PF. Compare candidate and baseline by origin slot and report changed/same symbol and changed execution.
metrics.bCrowding: Report unchanged B signal slots and actual B trade count/PnL/capital-days differences caused by A capital use.

decisionRule.stage: Historical candidate screen only; passing does not certify profitability or OOS success.
decisionRule.participationFloorMeaning: 80percent is a predeclared practical guardrail, not statistical proof and never a substitute for positive expectancy.

uncertainty.calendar: All aligned evaluation sessions including cash/zero-trade days
uncertainty.measure: Mean daily return difference in basis points
uncertainty.meaning: Retrospective dependent-return resampling, not multiple-selection correction, cumulative-return confidence interval, or prospective proof.

oos.status: Not yet available at a sufficient independent length
oos.newSegmentConsumption: No prices or returns after2026-10-15 read in this study.
oos.requires: Rules/code/input identity frozen before observing that session; append-only simulated records; no real orders; verify published trading calendar; no parameter reselection from forward outcomes.

limitations: Historical raw-price/survivor cohort, incomplete historic status/actions and single-open capacity approximations remain.
Both historical periods have been used before; development hypothesis discovery is adaptive.
Two ranking experiments cannot establish a causal market mechanism.
No genuine OOS profitability is available; no real orders or production promotion.
